title: Adventures in Abstract Paint Pouring
includes: All painting materials and supplies are included - an 11x14 canvas is provided for the experience.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Abstract acrylic paint pouring is the perfect experience for those who want to have some creative time with family or friends while enjoying the process of creating art fearlessly. 

All materials, including an 11x14 canvas as well as a 15-minute demonstration are included in this experience. 

We have a cafe on-site where you can order light pastries, coffee, tea or treats.
